scale: 0 unfavorable/missing, 1 weak, 2 workable after bounded adaptation, 3 favorable for stated scope; higher is better; 36 maximum

criteria.M: Existing provider maturity for this operation

scope: Source-derived assessment, not measured benchmarks. S01 privacy score applies only to generated shareable inputs. Current private profiles are not remotely eligible.

candidates.name: Named NAL truth deduction
candidates.rationale: Pure named function has a clean numerical boundary, tiny payload and exact local oracle; generated shareable STVs need no migration. A new kernel/input/execution profile is required. Compute saving is negligible; value is proving composition and numerical ownership without a foreign-state dependency.

candidates.name: Bounded external web search
candidates.rationale: Low local state coupling and easy call-path seam, but DDGS output is nondeterministic, exceptions currently look empty and upstream requests cannot be exactly-once. Useful execution precedent; weaker test oracle and fewer core module boundaries than S01.

candidates.name: Core memory read composition
candidates.rationale: High architectural/offload value, but current payload/vector/links/truth are one Chroma owner, timestamps are ambiguous and there is no accepted source feed. Vector and promotion profiles, identity and privacy decisions block an honest drop-in cut. No populated-state migration.

candidates.name: Episode provenance plus belief revision
candidates.rationale: Owner split and C1/C2 recovery patterns exist in Fusion, but legacy STVs lack evidence roots and NAL math differs. Existing private profiles explicitly require local placement. Authority/provenance gaps precede any remote experiment.

candidates.name: Promotion ranking/adjustment
candidates.rationale: SQLite is a recognizable owner, but wall-clock power decay, timestamps and replay ambiguity differ from STI. Compute benefit is near zero; preserve separate policy and defer populated-state transfer.

candidates.name: Durable mailbox plus channel adapters
candidates.rationale: Durable Fusion mailbox is mature for its profile; channel delivery and identity mapping are not. Lost ingress and ambiguous IRC egress cannot be repaired by moving the buffer. Requires explicit transport semantics and private route policy.

candidates.name: Model completion
candidates.rationale: Already calls remote APIs, but no model port or pinned SDK/runtime semantics. Prompt privacy, billing/retry ambiguity and credential scope dominate. Moving another wrapper offers less value than clarifying the missing contract.

candidates.name: Embedding generation
candidates.rationale: Separate model owner and potential compute benefit; model/dimension/normalization compatibility absent and existing vectors cannot silently switch. Text and vectors remain private. New corpus only avoids migration.

candidates.name: Perception and image capture
candidates.rationale: Video bandwidth, reset state, media consent/identity, retention, continuous threads and hosted image completion are entangled. No perception port or replayable capture receipt; future offload value is real but not ready.

candidates.name: Arbitrary shell/MeTTa/filesystem
candidates.rationale: No declared bounded effect, sandbox, path scope or recoverable identity. A generic execution envelope would hide rather than solve these constraints. Scores do not authorize a service.
